# David Perla writes for New York Law Journal about AI in law and legal finance


February 10, 2025


-
-
-
-


Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) writes for the *New York Law Journal* about AI in law and legal finance.


In the article entitled "AI in Legal: Disruptive Potential and Practical Realities," Perla discusses the legal industry's approach to AI investment, industry obstacles to AI adoption and more.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law.com/newyorklawjournal/2025/02/10/ai-in-legal-disruptive-potential-and-practical-realities-/)
